subject.title: feat(ios): Talk camera flip control and mic input selection

question: Should a persisted Talk camera selection alter the public default for every iOS node capture that omits `facing`, or should it be carried explicitly only by Talk-originated capture requests?
rationale: The branch cannot satisfy its stated Talk behavior through the normal agent path without changing where facing is selected, and the two alternatives have different public API and upgrade semantics.

options.title: Scope the choice to Talk captures
options.body: Preserve `front` as the generic omitted-facing contract and pass an explicit Talk-originated camera choice into the relevant capture request path.

options.title: Adopt an iOS-wide persisted default
options.body: Accept the platform-specific public behavior change, update the camera documentation and compatibility tests, and prove direct and agent-originated capture semantics.

options.title: Defer the camera behavior
options.body: Land only the independently useful microphone wiring after separating it from the unresolved camera-default contract.

recommendation.title: Scope the choice to Talk captures
recommendation.body: Preserve `front` as the generic omitted-facing contract and pass an explicit Talk-originated camera choice into the relevant capture request path.

likelyOwner.reason: The proposed iOS Talk behavior and its implementation boundary are concentrated in the commits listed above, though current-main ownership evidence remains limited.
